runtime.settings.locale.title: Interface language
runtime.settings.locale.impact: Controls how subsequent operations present messages.
runtime.settings.runtime.shutdownGraceMs: Wait this many milliseconds before cancelling active operations.
Takes effect at the next shutdown.
runtime.settings.runtime.ioConcurrency.d: Set the number of concurrent I/O operations.
runtime.settings.runtime.ioConcurrency.i: Changes capacity used by subsequent operations.
runtime.settings.logging.level.title: Log level
runtime.settings.logging.level.descripti: Set the minimum severity to record.
runtime.settings.logging.level.impact: Changes the logging level for subsequent operations.
runtime.settings.logging.file.title: Log file
runtime.settings.logging.file.descriptio: Write structured diagnostics to the instance log directory.
runtime.settings.logging.file.impact: Enables or disables writing new file logs.
runtime.settings.logging.rotateBytes.des: Rotate the log at this many bytes.
runtime.settings.logging.rotateBytes.imp: Determines when the active log file is replaced.
runtime.settings.logging.maxFiles.title: Retained log files
runtime.settings.logging.maxFiles.descri: Set how many rotated logs to keep.
runtime.settings.logging.maxFiles.impact: Changes how many old logs remain on disk.
runtime.settings.logging.captureModelCon: Save sanitized model request and response attachments under logs/model-content.
Controls diagnostic attachments for subsequent model calls.
runtime.settings.network.timeoutMs.title: Network timeout
runtime.settings.network.timeoutMs.descr: Set one HTTP attempt's timeout in milliseconds.
runtime.settings.network.proxy.title: HTTP proxy
runtime.settings.network.proxy.descripti: Supply an HTTP(S) proxy URL without credentials.
runtime.settings.network.proxy.impact: Routes subsequent requests through this proxy.
runtime.settings.network.proxyAuthorizat: Reference the complete Proxy-Authorization value using env: or file:.
Supplies authentication to the configured proxy.
runtime.settings.network.caFile.title: Additional CA certificates
runtime.settings.network.caFile.descript: Enter a path to the PEM certificate file.
runtime.settings.network.caFile.impact: Adds certificate authorities for TLS verification.
